# function: repeat

Create a value that repeats the given value `n` times.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
repeat(value dynamic, n number) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `value` (Dynamic, Nullable) value to repeat
1. `n` (Number) number of times to repeat the value
